reason: I know what to look for on a wheel, and a new seller with no reviews telling me 'checked for bends and cracks' is just their word. I can get used sets on Marketplace or eBay for less and inspect them myself.
objection: No reviews, and I can't see how the repair was done. Hidden cracks or a bend under the refinish would cost me, and £300 is a big part of my budget for something I can't verify.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me inspect the actual set in person before paying, with photos of the repairs and a straightened-and-crack-tested check I can see, or a price nearer £200.
